name: watch-this
//overrides: Every entry below must earn its place: an override silently violates what a
dependency declared it can work with, so it is only worth it to reach a
patched version the tree cannot otherwise resolve.
postcss ^8.5.18 -- load-bearing. Without it the tree also resolves 8.4.31
and 8.5.15, both inside GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849 (high, <=8.5.17).
sharp ^0.35.4 -- load-bearing. Without it sharp drops to 0.34.5, inside
GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj (high, <0.35.0). The floor is 0.35.4 rather than
0.35.3 because of GHSA-rgj7-g3m4-5g8c (high, <0.35.4, bundled libheif).
@types/react, @types/react-dom -- pinned to match the react/react-dom
versions exactly; React 19 types are not compatible across minors.
SUPPLY-13: brace-expansion is still NOT overridden, and no longer needs
to be. The versions this tree resolves -- 1.1.21 under eslint's
minimatch@3 and 2.1.7 under typescript-eslint's minimatch@9 -- are both
past the backported fixes for GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg and GHSA-rgw5-rvv9-x895,
so `npm audit` is clean without one. An override would still be wrong: the
5.x line changed its export from `module.exports = expand` to `{ expand }`
and those two minimatch majors call the import directly, so pinning ^5
breaks `eslint .` with 'expand is not a function'. Leave it unpinned and
let each consumer resolve the API it declares.
SUPPLY-04: ajv, @babel/core, flatted, ws and js-yaml were removed because
the tree resolves to the same patched versions without them. picomatch was
removed for a stronger reason: it forced micromatch (which declares ^2.3.1)
across two majors to 4.0.4, and micromatch's own resolution is 2.3.2 --
already the patched version, since the advisories are ranged <2.3.2. It
bought nothing and violated a declared range.
SUPPLY-05: esbuild is still NOT overridden globally. Four consumers declare
mutually disjoint ranges (vite ^0.27.0, tsx ~0.28.0, drizzle-kit ^0.25.4,
@esbuild-kit/core-utils ~0.18.20), so no single version satisfies them and
any blanket pin violates three of the four. The old ^0.28.1 pin was for
GHSA-gv7w-rqvm-qjhr, which was WITHDRAWN on 2026-06-17.
What IS pinned is one scoped override: esbuild ^0.25.12 under
@esbuild-kit/core-utils only, which clears GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99 (moderate,
<=0.24.2) without touching the esbuild that vite, tsx or drizzle-kit
resolve for themselves. It is the only remaining path npm audit flags, and
nothing else can clear it: @esbuild-kit/* is deprecated and pinned to
esbuild ~0.18.20 forever, drizzle-kit only drops the dependency in its
1.0.0 prereleases, and `npm audit fix --force` would DOWNGRADE drizzle-kit
to 0.18.1. The override is safe because drizzle-kit 0.31 declares
@esbuild-kit/esm-loader but never imports it -- it loads configs through
tsx -- and because the transform API core-utils calls is unchanged between
0.18 and 0.25. ^0.25.12 also dedupes onto the esbuild drizzle-kit already
resolves, and stays clear of GHSA-g7r4-m6w7-qqqr (0.27.3 - 0.28.0).
Drop the override once drizzle-kit 1.0 is stable.
